# Tagvico

> Tagvico is an open-source, self-hosted companion for Paperless-ngx that turns documents into reviewable metadata, archive research, actions, deadlines, and recoverable automation.

## Product facts

- Category: Paperless-ngx document automation and research
- Deployment: self-hosted with Docker
- License: MIT
- Source of truth: Paperless-ngx remains the document archive
- Write boundary: metadata and tag changes can be reviewed before they are applied
- Model options: local Ollama, compatible APIs, ChatGPT subscription, and GitHub Copilot
